scope: Crate roots and contracts for ownership rows 21 through 25

crate_handoffs.root_implementation: Four proc macro entry points, span-safe compile errors, shared immutable derive AST, attribute defaults, literal escaping and dispatch
Canonical ABI re-exports, borrowed image projection, typed slot plans, checked owner-bound slot reader, authoritative canonical fingerprint and compiler facades, Rust identifier/path/literal helpers
Canonical endpoint re-exports, version and metadata records, immutable borrowed registry layout, versioned legacy documents, wire naming policies and PostgreSQL/header helper types
Located bounded configuration syntax, resource limits, defaults/version requirements, input-size validation and complete load-normalize-validate-version orchestration
Generator options, complete artifact and registry-pair types, deterministic collision-checked insertion, portable path validation, crate path validation and six-artifact generation orchestration

dependency_alignment: Schema identity delegates to jmax-schema-ir normalization, resolution and canonical fingerprint APIs with default policy; no competing fingerprint grammar
Compilation and complete program loading delegate to jmax-schema-compile through the AOT facade
Compiler opcode bytes are 1 through 14 and StateId addresses the state vector, not instructions
Static ABI image projections are distinguished from complete validated programs with executable side tables
Boolean flat schemas use the upstream True/False-to-Boolean adapter convention
Rust schema_tables.rs output matches the adjacent generator CLI artifact requirement
wave_requirements: Implement only each later wave's owned module against the exact contract signatures; module files are intentionally not created by Wave 0
No wave may redefine ABI types, expose proc macro helper modules publicly, or add unlisted dependencies
Schema and slot identities must agree across derives, compiler images, registries and decoders
Optional scalar properties permit absence, not explicit JSON null; unsupported flat-schema projections must fail explicitly
RON and version metadata parsing use the documented bounded grammar without adding parser dependencies
Generated files are returned in memory and complete executable schema side tables are retained

verification.method: Source and adjacent contract inspection only
